item.title: We’re introducing Gemini 3.5 — our latest family of AI models combining frontier intelligence with action. We’re starting the rollout with Gemini 3...
item.description:
We’re introducing Gemini 3.5 — our latest family of AI models combining frontier intelligence with action.
We’re starting the rollout with Gemini 3.5 Flash, our strongest agentic and coding model yet. Whether you're writing complex code or streamlining your daily workflow, we designed this model to help you get more done. It can tackle heavy-lifting tasks at four times the speed of comparable AI models — often at less than half the cost.
Because Gemini 3.5 Flash is now our default model, you'll experience this leap in speed and intelligence across the tools you already use, from the Gemini app to AI Mode in Search and across our developer platforms.
Learn more → goo.gle/4nFp9iY
